name: OSE
description: Ogx Scripting Engine. Scripts are written between {{ and }} inside HTML templates and inside OML values whose key ends with :OSE.

variables.meaning: The optional data object. In a template, {{$title}} prints data.title.
The thread data object. Loop variables are read with this prefix.
The route data object. {{%}} is the whole capture or query string. {{%id}} is one capture. crumb id reads the same capture.

variable_names: A variable name starts with a letter or an underscore.

keywords.name: template
keywords.use: template MyTemplate returns that preloaded HTML template. template MyTemplate SomeObject fills it. {{template $mytemplate}} uses a name from data.

keywords.name: json
keywords.use: json myfile returns a preloaded JSON document. {{json list}} is the file list.json. {{json %id}} uses a captured id as the file name.

keywords.name: oml
keywords.use: oml myfile returns a preloaded OML document. node:OML may be the string myfile or {{oml myfile}}.

keywords.name: ose
keywords.use: ose myfile runs another preloaded script.

keywords.name: echo
keywords.use: Appends to the return text. Quotes around the echoed markup can be omitted. return does the same for the whole result.

keywords.name: loop
keywords.use: loop $images as index image, or loop $object as property value. The new names are read with &.

keywords.name: scope
keywords.use: scope admin manager ? template Manager : template Employee

keywords.name: screen
keywords.use: screen > 500 ? template Big : template Small compares the app width.

keywords.name: uxi
keywords.use: uxi mySwitch:Switch points at a live object.

keywords.name: method
keywords.use: method toggle() mySwitch:Switch runs that method. Without parentheses it only points at the method.

keywords.name: function
keywords.use: function myGlobalFunction() runs a global function. An inline function can return a value, as in a Display template name.

keywords.name: result
keywords.use: result function_id reads the value of a Promise returned by a function.

loop_example: {{ loop $images as index image { echo ; } }}
assign_example: {{ @rows = json myfile.mylist; loop @rows as index object { echo &object.name; } }}
callbacks: A callback in OML can be written as myCallback($). DynamicList also accepts callbacks.select, callbacks.unselect, and callbacks.render.
rules: Use OSE for derived values. Static config stays plain JSON.
Preload the template, json, oml, or ose file before the script names it.
